name: std::ranges::split_view<V,Pattern>::find_next

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
it

 -

 an iterator to the position at which to start the search

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A subrange that represents the next position of the pattern, if it was found. An empty subrange otherwise.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Split a character sequence at commas. begin and iterator increment invoke the exposition-only find_next helper; inner/outer iterators read the lazy tokens.
